reuse.why: Fintegra uses the existing linking, bank-selection, HTTP and import helpers, while takeover and ordinary unlinking share the extracted clearAccountLink.

duplication.why: The new Fintegra account-list and transaction-download functions duplicate their Akahu equivalents with provider-name and endpoint substitutions.

placement.why: Link policies remain in the shared account-link orchestrator, downloads remain in sync.ts, and provider configuration and types follow existing layers.

scope.why: The change largely follows the four requests, although the additional fintegra-accounts endpoint extends beyond the specified linking and transaction API.

maintainability.why: Centralized link validation and shared unlink state are straightforward to maintain, but copied provider networking adds avoidable maintenance.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider link handlers use linkBankSyncAccount, which continues to use findOrCreateBank; takeover shares clearAccountLink with unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: fintegraAccounts in accounts/app.ts and downloadFintegraTransactions in accounts/sync.ts reproduce the corresponding Akahu functions under different provider names and endpoints.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink and an opt-in takeover branch; this is requested variation, and every provider continues through the shared helper.
